transformations.rationale: The Rust method receiver `self` is represented as the explicit Verus parameter `slice`; the public target remains executable and carries the generated key-selection contract.

The Rust 1.96 body passes `|a: &T, b: &T| f(a).lt(&f(b))` to `sort::select::partition_at_index`. This Verus build cannot typecheck that mutable FnMut key closure directly, so the harness lowers only that adapter to the named source-backed `partition_at_index_by_key` boundary while preserving the key extraction and Ord::lt comparison intent.

The recursive private introselect implementation behind `sort::select::partition_at_index` is isolated as a named source-backed helper boundary. The public target function is executable and not `external_body`.
